name: company-registry-filings-aggregator
title: Company Registry & Filings Aggregator
description: Research official company identity, websites/domains, registered offices, previous names, and normalized filing changes from SEC EDGAR and UK Companies House—without officer, PSC, email, phone, or personal-contact fields.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

company-record-scraped.eventDescription: Charged once for each clean official company or filing record saved to the dataset.
